definitions.explanation: The state of not speaking or remaining silent. Can describe a person who says nothing or the atmosphere of silence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無言|むごん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
{無言|むごん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{圧力|あつりょく}→圧力：12014_atsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。

⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無言|むごん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{気|き}まずい→気まずい：06536_kimazui⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: The two continued eating in silence, and an awkward atmosphere hung in the air.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the pattern {無言|むごん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま (remaining silent) or {無言|むごん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (silently). Implies a deliberate or meaningful silence, not just the absence of sound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無言|むごん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: remaining silent
- {無言|むごん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{圧力|あつりょく}→圧力：12014_atsuryoku⟧: unspoken pressure, silent pressure
- {無言|むごん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{立|た}ち{去|さ}る→立ち去る：04640_tachisaru⟧: to leave without a word
- {無言|むごん}⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧: silent phone call (prank call with no speaking)
